name: Fuselight
summary: Fuselight is a fledgling goblin settlement nestled within the jagged passes of the Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands. Founded and operated by the enterprising Steamwheedle Cartel, this outpost serves as a base for research, resource gathering, and unconventional laboratories.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Ravine
sections.body: Perched among the desolate red canyons of Lethlor Ravine, Fuselight represents a bold venture by the Steamwheedle Cartel into the harsh terrain of the Badlands. The settlement is not an ordinary frontier rest stop; it houses specialized goblin laboratories focused on industrial experimentation and trade opportunities. To sustain the venture and ensure manpower, recruiters like Gek Nozzlerocket operate as far away as the Eastern Plaguelands, seeking capable hands and daring mercenaries willing to work under the cartel's banner.

sections.title: Cartel Enterprise
sections.body: Unlike many smaller, isolated goblin camps that operate autonomously, Fuselight maintains direct operational ties with the broader Steamwheedle enterprise. Performing work here contributes directly to a traveler's standing with the cartel. Surrounded by dragonkin and rocky wilderness, the settlement relies on hired muscle to secure its fragile hold on the ravine.

faq.answer: Fuselight is a settlement founded by the Steamwheedle Cartel in the Lethlor Ravine within the Badlands. It features goblin laboratories and serves as an outpost for industrial enterprise in an otherwise unforgiving canyon.
Fuselight is owned and operated by the Steamwheedle Cartel. As a neutral goblin settlement, it welcomes both Alliance and Horde travelers willing to do business or lend a hand.
Fuselight is located in the eastern portion of the Badlands, tucked inside the craggy expanse of the Lethlor Ravine.

faq.q: Why is there a recruiter in the Eastern Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Gek Nozzlerocket recruits daring adventurers and laborers from the Eastern Plaguelands to bolster Fuselight's workforce, drawing on seasoned wanderers willing to travel south for cartel coin.

angles.text: With its working laboratory and cartel technicians, Fuselight showcases the practical—and volatile—potentials of goblin engineering out in the field.
